verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Settings Library for adding skills and MCP servers. That is a tool and MCP-client extension mechanism, not documented support for integrating third-party, partner-built agent apps. No partner ecosystem, app marketplace, or third-party agent-app integration is described, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
